Chapter 220 - State Highway System

NRS 220.160 Administration of the highway system.

The department of transportation shall administer the state highway system and shall have charge of the maintenance and repair thereof.

[1:21:1955]

NRS 220.170 Authority to acquire property.

The department may acquire, by purchase, condemnation or otherwise, such real property as is necessary for the construction and maintenance of highways.

Eminent domain may be exercised only as provided by law.

[1:21:1955; 1965, 219]

NRS 220.180

All moneys received by the department shall be deposited in the state highway fund.
